First, buy a 120-unit bond, no interest, locked 10 epochs; the yarrow rule is simple: only real work refreshes it.

Then, the bond loses 4% each epoch, and clones that wander without working fall below 60, lose rewards, and face downgrade, while forgery costs half the residual and freezes refresh 6 epochs.

Finally, count the cost: 1,000 clones invest 120,000, lose 4,800 per epoch, and after 10 idle epochs the dawn shows a net loss above 40,000.
